On-page SEO encompasses all controllable aspects of SEO on your website.

Off-page SEO encompasses factors outside your website, such as domain authority, trustworthiness, backlinks, and social metrics.

Natural links are given without direct action from the website owner.
Manually built links are acquired through outreach or requests, like guest blogging.
Self-created links are generated by the website owner, such as through directory listings.
